name: Dragon Endeavour (SpX DM-2)
about: Dragon Endeavour (SpX DM-2) (2020-033A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon 2), launched 2020 May 30. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2020 May 31), held fixed
docked to A08583; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
